title: Note frontmatter
description: Frontmatter contract for every .md outside inbox/. Until the last 0.x release a reader also accepts the Dutch names of note/2 (with a warning); see the specification, Migration from 0.14.

name.description: Slug, equal to the file name without .md

description.description: One line, at most 250 characters. Required (the lint warns until the brain has filled in all notes, an error after that)

status.description: archived: stays findable, the chat and the tiles ignore it unless you ask for it; need not be in the hub any more

attachments.description: Paths of the originals in attachments/<name>/; each must exist

area.description: Slug of a hub note in areas/ (areas/<area>.md exists)

scope.description: Optional. persona: only in persona/, imported from the persona repo by Persona-Sync; never by hand

idea.description: With ideas: where the idea stands

experience.description: Optional. The note is about something the owner learned from; what, is under a heading '## What I learned' (otherwise Feed your twin asks)

original.description: Optional. none: there is no original to upload (Feed your twin stops asking)

kind.description: Optional. The kind of a document or project, in the owner's words (contract, policy, plan, …)

date.description: Optional. The date of a document

valid-until.description: Optional. Until when a document is valid

bundles.description: Optional. Slugs from bundles.json; the first is the main bundle (color on the map). Wins over the rules in bundles.json

share.description: Optional. never: never share, not in a bundle either; always wins (source: client is always never)

reviewed.description: Optional. Date in YYYY-MM-DD on which the content was checked on purpose; not in the future

superseded-by.description: Optional. name of the note that replaces this one as a whole (must exist); the chat follows the reference

keep-until.description: Optional. Until when something that is only interesting is kept (default six months); the maintenance round presents it afterwards

readers.description: Optional. Who besides the owner may read this note (ids from readers.json); overrides the default of the hub; empty is the owner only. Not with source: client
